d:
The Golmaal Again cast (Ajay Devgn, Tusshar Kapoor, Kunal Kemmu, and Shreyas Talpade) arrive in Gokuldham disguised as ghosts to surprise the residents. After playful banter and laughter, Ajay Devgn reveals the ultimate "golmaal"—he had secretly moved all the crackers and sweets to the clubhouse.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
